name: Ian H. Fisher
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Chicago, Illinois
about: Ian H. Fisher is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2005, 2010 - 2027. He works at Taft Stettinius & Hollister LLP, located in Chicago, Illinois, and provides legal services for issues involving Business Litigation and Class Action / Mass Torts: Defense to the surrounding community.
Ian Fisher completed legal studies at Northwestern University School of Law and graduated with the class of 1994. Ian Fisher passed the bar in 1994.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
